name: The Rope Bridge
hours: Open; the only dry crossing of the Split, the ravine that cuts the island's waist. Maintained by Silas twice a year.
sight: The trail ends at a lip of rock and continues as sixty metres of plank and cable over a ravine so deep the river at the bottom is a white thread. The bridge sags in the middle and sings in the wind. On the far side the jungle is darker and older, and the volcano is suddenly very large. A tin sign says ONE AT A TIME and somebody has added a card-game joke about stack limits.
things: Cross it. Do not look down. Look down.
Wait your turn and talk to whoever is waiting too
Count the planks that have been replaced and the ones that should be
Drop a pebble and count the seconds
Read the knots: prayer ribbons, hair ties and sleeves tied to the cables by people who made it across
Tie on something of your own
Find the old stone abutments of a much earlier bridge, just upstream
secret: The threshold between the 'school' half of the island and the old half; everything north of here costs real time. A Nerve test the first time (failing is funny, not fatal: Baylee or Viktor walks you over). The old abutments are Tessellate. D29: the school's cordon post is HERE, at the campus-side anchor (the 'north trailhead') — two unnamed proctors by day, a chain across the planks by night; the official line is rockfall on the north slope. Ways past: Viktor's ravine descent upstream, the cliff path and coast, a boat, or permission. From D61 Marrow's field assistants use the bridge freely and carry cases over. On the far side, from D27, there are no birds at all.
access: From Day 29 guarded and chained: no students beyond without written permission (ashdown can issue a field-section pass for the ruins; nobody issues one for the north slope).
